hook.name: Psyche
hook.description: An ERC20 token (ECHO) combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that applies variable swap surcharges (5–50 bps) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, scaled by each swapper's contribution coefficient — a weighted product of token tenure, balance weight, and swap witness count. Higher-coefficient holders pay lower surcharges; the surcharge differential routes back to liquidity providers.
